### Database & Container Setup
# Recreate database container with pgvector support
docker compose up -d --force-recreate

# Connect to database shell
docker exec -it doctask-postgres psql -U user -d doctask

# Enable pgvector extension (run inside the psql shell)
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

### Alembic Migrations Setup
# Initialize Alembic migrations directory (run inside backend folder)
cd backend
../venv/bin/alembic init alembic

# Generate the initial autogenerated migration
cd backend
PYTHONPATH=. ../venv/bin/alembic revision --autogenerate -m "initial"

# Apply all migrations to the database
cd backend
PYTHONPATH=. ../venv/bin/alembic upgrade head

# Downgrade the last applied migration
cd backend
PYTHONPATH=. ../venv/bin/alembic downgrade -1

# Show migration history
cd backend
../venv/bin/alembic history --verbose

# Show current migration status of database
cd backend
PYTHONPATH=. ../venv/bin/alembic current

### Formatting and Linting Setup
# Install formatting tools (black/ruff)
venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt

# Format the backend code
make format
# Or manually: cd backend && ../venv/bin/black app/

# Lint and auto-fix the backend code
make lint
# Or manually: cd backend && ../venv/bin/ruff check app/ --fix

### Database & Migration Resetting
# Drop all tables and enums in Postgres to start clean
docker exec doctask-postgres psql -U user -d doctask -c "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS alembic_version CASCADE; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS reports CASCADE; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS findings CASCADE; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS documents CASCADE; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS workflow_events CASCADE; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS runs CASCADE; DROP TYPE IF EXISTS document_types CASCADE; DROP TYPE IF EXISTS finding_severity CASCADE; DROP TYPE IF EXISTS review_decision CASCADE; DROP TYPE IF EXISTS workflow_stage CASCADE; DROP TYPE IF EXISTS runstatus CASCADE;"

# Create autogenerated migration again
cd backend
PYTHONPATH=. ../venv/bin/alembic revision --autogenerate -m "create initial domain tables"

# Apply the migrations
PYTHONPATH=. ../venv/bin/alembic upgrade head
